name: Stalemate
source:
The story follows Chihiro, the captain of a high school chess club, and her friend Daisuke as they recruit new members. There's Henry, the enigmatic 3rd year who's never been serious one day in his life. Kendo, the constantly apologizing first year who's never quite learned how to take his foot out of his mouth. And Tanaka, the quiet, (probably a?) delinquent first year. Join our crew as they navigate their way both on and off the board!

[From [url=https://rubaexe.itch.io/stalemate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了高中国际象棋俱乐部队长千寻和她的朋友大辅招募新成员的故事。亨利是一位神秘的三年级学生，他一生中从未有过认真的一天。剑道，一个不断道歉的一年级学生，他从来没有完全学会如何把自己的脚从嘴里拿出来。还有田中，那个安静的、（可能是？）不良的一年级学生。加入我们的船员，了解他们在船上和船上的航行方式！

[来自[url=https://rubaexe.itch.io/stalemate]Itch.io[/url]]
